card.line: Ephrath, also called Bethlehem, is a city that Jacob's family was traveling toward when Rachel died on the road after giving birth to Benjamin.

moments.title: Rachel's hard labor
moments.text: Jacob's family left Bethel, and while they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel began a difficult labor. The midwife told her not to be afraid, because she was having another son.

moments.title: Rachel dies on the way
moments.text: Rachel named her son Ben-oni with her last breath, but Jacob called him Benjamin. She was buried on the way to Ephrath, and Jacob set up a pillar on her grave.
